[index.html](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/28370185/index.html)
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="ko">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Time x Pitch</title>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Press+Start+2P&family=Share+Tech+Mono&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
  * { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }

  :root {
    --accent: #ff00ff;
    --accent-dim: #ff00ff44;
    --accent-glow: #ff00ff22;
    --bg: #0a0a0f;
    --green: #00ff88;
  }

  body {
    background-color: var(--bg);
    min-height: 100vh;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    font-family: 'Share Tech Mono', monospace;
    color: #e0e0e0;
    overflow-x: hidden;
  }

  /* ─── 스타 파티클 캔버스 ─── */
  #star-canvas {
    position: fixed;
    inset: 0;
    z-index: 0;
    pointer-events: none;
  }

  /* ─── 오로라 블롭 ─── */
  .aurora {
    position: fixed;
    border-radius: 50%;
    filter: blur(80px);
    pointer-events: none;
    z-index: 0;
    mix-blend-mode: screen;
  }
  .aurora-1 {
    width: 600px; height: 400px;
    top: -100px; left: -150px;
    background: radial-gradient(ellipse, #3d0066 0%, transparent 70%);
    animation: aurora-drift-1 18s ease-in-out infinite;
  }
  .aurora-2 {
    width: 500px; height: 500px;
    top: 30%; right: -200px;
    background: radial-gradient(ellipse, #00004d 0%, transparent 70%);
    animation: aurora-drift-2 22s ease-in-out infinite;
  }
  .aurora-3 {
    width: 700px; height: 300px;
    bottom: 15%; left: 10%;
    background: radial-gradient(ellipse, #330033 0%, transparent 70%);
    animation: aurora-drift-3 16s ease-in-out infinite;
  }
  .aurora-4 {
    width: 400px; height: 400px;
    top: 20%; left: 30%;
    background: radial-gradient(ellipse, #1a0033 0%, transparent 70%);
    animation: aurora-drift-1 25s ease-in-out infinite reverse;
    opacity: 0.6;
  }
  @keyframes aurora-drift-1 {
    0%,100% { transform: translate(0,0) scale(1); }
    33%      { transform: translate(60px,-40px) scale(1.1); }
    66%      { transform: translate(-40px,30px) scale(0.95); }
  }
  @keyframes aurora-drift-2 {
    0%,100% { transform: translate(0,0) scale(1); }
    40%      { transform: translate(-80px,50px) scale(1.15); }
    70%      { transform: translate(30px,-60px) scale(0.9); }
  }
  @keyframes aurora-drift-3 {
    0%,100% { transform: translate(0,0) scale(1); }
    50%      { transform: translate(50px,-30px) scale(1.2); }
  }

  /* ─── 하단 앰비언트 글로우 ─── */
  .bottom-glow {
    position: fixed;
    bottom: 0; left: 0; right: 0;
    height: 35vh;
    background: radial-gradient(ellipse 80% 100% at 50% 100%,
      rgba(120,0,120,0.22) 0%,
      rgba(60,0,80,0.12) 40%,
      transparent 100%);
    pointer-events: none;
    z-index: 2;
  }

  /* ─── 인트로 오버레이 ─── */
  #intro {
    position: fixed;
    inset: 0;
    z-index: 9000;
    background: #06060c;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    cursor: none;
    transition: opacity 0.9s ease;
  }
  #intro.hidden {
    opacity: 0;
    pointer-events: none;
  }
  /* 인트로 CRT 스캔라인 */
  #intro::before {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    background: repeating-linear-gradient(
      0deg, transparent, transparent 2px,
      rgba(0,0,0,0.1) 2px, rgba(0,0,0,0.1) 4px
    );
    pointer-events: none;
  }
  /* 인트로 비네트 */
  #intro::after {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    background: radial-gradient(ellipse at center,
      transparent 35%, rgba(0,0,0,0.75) 100%);
    pointer-events: none;
  }
  .intro-inner {
    position: relative;
    z-index: 1;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 28px;
  }
  /* 상단 장식 라인 */
  .intro-bar {
    width: 180px; height: 1px;
    background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, #ff00ff55, transparent);
    margin-bottom: 4px;
  }
  .intro-label {
    font-family: 'Share Tech Mono', monospace;
    font-size: 10px;
    color: #ff00ff44;
    letter-spacing: 6px;
    text-transform: uppercase;
  }
  /* 메인 CLICK 텍스트 */
  .intro-click {
    font-family: 'Press Start 2P', monospace;
    font-size: clamp(22px, 5vw, 38px);
    color: #fff;
    letter-spacing: 6px;
    text-align: center;
    line-height: 1.5;
    position: relative;
    text-shadow:
      0 0 20px #ff00ff,
      0 0 60px #ff00ff55,
      0 0 100px #ff00ff22;
    animation: intro-pulse 2.4s ease-in-out infinite;
  }
  /* 글리치 효과 */
  .intro-click::before {
    content: attr(data-text);
    position: absolute;
    left: 0; top: 0;
    color: #00ffff;
    clip-path: polygon(0 0, 100% 0, 100% 40%, 0 40%);
    animation: intro-glitch 4s infinite;
    opacity: 0;
    text-shadow: none;
  }
  .intro-click::after {
    content: attr(data-text);
    position: absolute;
    left: 0; top: 0;
    color: #ff2060;
    clip-path: polygon(0 60%, 100% 60%, 100% 100%, 0 100%);
    animation: intro-glitch 4s infinite 0.05s;
    opacity: 0;
    text-shadow: none;
  }
  @keyframes intro-glitch {
    0%,80%,100% { opacity:0; transform:translateX(0); }
    82% { opacity:.8; transform:translateX(-4px); }
    84% { opacity:0; transform:translateX(4px); }
    86% { opacity:.5; transform:translateX(-2px); }
    88% { opacity:0; }
  }
  @keyframes intro-pulse {
    0%,100% { opacity:1; }
    50%      { opacity:0.55; }
  }
  /* 하단 서브텍스트 */
  .intro-sub {
    font-family: 'Share Tech Mono', monospace;
    font-size: 10px;
    color: #333;
    letter-spacing: 4px;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    animation: blink 1.4s step-end infinite;
  }
  .intro-bar-bot {
    width: 120px; height: 1px;
    background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, #ffffff11, transparent);
  }

  /* 인트로 배경 오로라 (살짝 다르게) */
  .intro-aurora {
    position: absolute;
    border-radius: 50%;
    filter: blur(100px);
    pointer-events: none;
    animation: aurora-drift-1 20s ease-in-out infinite;
  }
  .intro-aurora-1 {
    width: 500px; height: 400px;
    top: -100px; left: -100px;
    background: radial-gradient(ellipse, #2d0055 0%, transparent 70%);
    animation-delay: 0s;
  }
  .intro-aurora-2 {
    width: 600px; height: 350px;
    bottom: -80px; right: -150px;
    background: radial-gradient(ellipse, #1a0040 0%, transparent 70%);
    animation: aurora-drift-2 24s ease-in-out infinite;
  }
  .intro-aurora-3 {
    width: 300px; height: 300px;
    top: 40%; left: 40%;
    background: radial-gradient(ellipse, #ff00ff08 0%, transparent 70%);
    animation: aurora-drift-3 18s ease-in-out infinite;
  }

  /* ─── 레트로 그리드 배경 ─── */
  .grid-bg {
    position: fixed;
    inset: 0;
    z-index: 1;
    background-image:
      linear-gradient(rgba(255,0,255,0.025) 1px, transparent 1px),
      linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(255,0,255,0.025) 1px, transparent 1px);
    background-size: 40px 40px;
    pointer-events: none;
  }

  /* ─── 상단 수평선 빛줄기 (대기 효과) ─── */
  .horizon-glow {
    position: fixed;
    bottom: 35%;
    left: 0; right: 0;
    height: 1px;
    background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent 0%, #ff00ff08 20%, #ff00ff18 50%, #ff00ff08 80%, transparent 100%);
    z-index: 2;
    pointer-events: none;
    animation: horizon-pulse 4s ease-in-out infinite;
  }
  @keyframes horizon-pulse {
    0%,100% { opacity: 0.4; }
    50% { opacity: 1; }
  }

  /* ─── CRT 스캔라인 ─── */
  .scanline {
    position: fixed;
    inset: 0;
    background: repeating-linear-gradient(
      0deg,
      transparent,
      transparent 2px,
      rgba(0,0,0,0.06) 2px,
      rgba(0,0,0,0.06) 4px
    );
    pointer-events: none;
    z-index: 99;
  }

  /* ─── 비네트 효과 ─── */
  .vignette {
    position: fixed;
    inset: 0;
    background: radial-gradient(ellipse at center, transparent 40%, rgba(0,0,0,0.7) 100%);
    pointer-events: none;
    z-index: 3;
  }

  /* ─── 볼륨 토글 버튼 ─── */
  #vol-btn {
    position: fixed;
    top: 20px;
    left: 20px;
    z-index: 200;
    width: 44px;
    height: 44px;
    background: rgba(10,10,15,0.85);
    border: 1px solid #ff00ff33;
    border-radius: 8px;
    color: #888;
    cursor: pointer;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    transition: all 0.2s ease;
    backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
    font-size: 18px;
  }
  #vol-btn:hover {
    border-color: var(--accent-dim);
    color: var(--accent);
    box-shadow: 0 0 20px #ff00ff22;
  }
  #vol-btn.playing {
    color: var(--accent);
    border-color: #ff00ff55;
    box-shadow: 0 0 16px #ff00ff1a;
    animation: vol-pulse 2s ease-in-out infinite;
  }
  @keyframes vol-pulse {
    0%,100% { box-shadow: 0 0 10px #ff00ff1a; }
    50% { box-shadow: 0 0 24px #ff00ff33; }
  }

  /* ─── 오디오 이퀄라이저 바 ─── */
  #eq-bars {
    display: none;
    align-items: flex-end;
    gap: 2px;
    height: 14px;
  }
  #vol-btn.playing #eq-bars { display: flex; }
  #vol-btn.playing #vol-icon { display: none; }
  .eq-bar {
    width: 3px;
    background: var(--accent);
    border-radius: 1px;
    animation: eq-anim 0.8s ease-in-out infinite;
  }
  .eq-bar:nth-child(1) { height: 4px; animation-delay: 0s; }
  .eq-bar:nth-child(2) { height: 10px; animation-delay: 0.15s; }
  .eq-bar:nth-child(3) { height: 7px; animation-delay: 0.3s; }
  .eq-bar:nth-child(4) { height: 12px; animation-delay: 0.1s; }
  .eq-bar:nth-child(5) { height: 5px; animation-delay: 0.25s; }
  @keyframes eq-anim {
    0%,100% { transform: scaleY(1); }
    50% { transform: scaleY(0.3); }
  }

  /* ─── 메인 컨테이너 ─── */
  .container {
    position: relative;
    z-index: 10;
    width: 100%;
    max-width: 480px;
    padding: 48px 24px 64px;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
  }

  /* ─── 입장 애니메이션 ─── */
  .fade-up {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translateY(20px);
    animation: fadeUp 0.7s ease forwards;
  }
  @keyframes fadeUp {
    to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
  }
  .fade-up:nth-child(1) { animation-delay: 0.1s; }
  .fade-up:nth-child(2) { animation-delay: 0.2s; }
  .fade-up:nth-child(3) { animation-delay: 0.3s; }
  .fade-up:nth-child(4) { animation-delay: 0.4s; }
  .fade-up:nth-child(5) { animation-delay: 0.5s; }
  .fade-up:nth-child(6) { animation-delay: 0.55s; }
  .fade-up:nth-child(7) { animation-delay: 0.6s; }
  .fade-up:nth-child(8) { animation-delay: 0.65s; }
  .fade-up:nth-child(9) { animation-delay: 0.7s; }
  .fade-up:nth-child(10) { animation-delay: 0.75s; }

  /* ─── 브래킷 장식 ─── */
  .corner-bracket {
    font-family: 'Share Tech Mono', monospace;
    font-size: 11px;
    color: #ff00ff33;
    letter-spacing: 2px;
    margin-bottom: 28px;
    align-self: stretch;
    text-align: center;
  }

  /* ─── 아바타 ─── */
  .avatar-wrap {
    position: relative;
    margin-bottom: 22px;
  }

  .avatar-ring {
    position: absolute;
    inset: -8px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    border: 1px solid #ff00ff22;
    animation: ring-rotate 8s linear infinite;
  }
  .avatar-ring::before {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    top: -2px; left: 50%;
    width: 6px; height: 6px;
    background: var(--accent);
    border-radius: 50%;
    transform: translateX(-50%);
    box-shadow: 0 0 12px var(--accent);
  }
  @keyframes ring-rotate {
    to { transform: rotate(360deg); }
  }

  .avatar {
    width: 100px;
    height: 100px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, #1a0028, #0d001a);
    border: 2px solid #ff00ff44;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    font-family: 'Press Start 2P', monospace;
    font-size: 20px;
    color: var(--accent);
    position: relative;
    overflow: hidden;
    box-shadow:
      0 0 0 4px #0a0a0f,
      0 0 0 6px #ff00ff1a,
      0 0 40px #ff00ff18;
  }
  .avatar::before {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    background: linear-gradient(45deg, transparent 30%, rgba(255,0,255,0.06) 50%, transparent 70%);
    animation: shimmer 3s infinite linear;
  }
  @keyframes shimmer {
    0% { transform: rotate(0deg) scale(2); }
    100% { transform: rotate(360deg) scale(2); }
  }

  .status-dot {
    position: absolute;
    bottom: 5px; right: 5px;
    width: 14px; height: 14px;
    background: var(--green);
    border-radius: 50%;
    border: 3px solid #0a0a0f;
    animation: dot-pulse 2.5s infinite;
  }
  @keyframes dot-pulse {
    0%,100% { box-shadow: 0 0 6px #00ff8877; }
    50% { box-shadow: 0 0 18px #00ff88bb; }
  }

  /* ─── 이름 — 글리치 효과 ─── */
  .name {
    font-family: 'Press Start 2P', monospace;
    font-size: 13px;
    color: var(--accent);
    letter-spacing: 1px;
    text-align: center;
    margin-bottom: 10px;
    line-height: 1.7;
    position: relative;
    text-shadow: 0 0 24px #ff00ff55;
  }
  .name::before, .name::after {
    content: attr(data-text);
    position: absolute;
    top: 0; left: 0; right: 0;
    overflow: hidden;
  }
  .name::before {
    color: #00ffff;
    text-shadow: none;
    clip-path: polygon(0 0, 100% 0, 100% 45%, 0 45%);
    animation: glitch-top 4s infinite;
    opacity: 0;
  }
  .name::after {
    color: #ff2060;
    text-shadow: none;
    clip-path: polygon(0 55%, 100% 55%, 100% 100%, 0 100%);
    animation: glitch-bot 4s infinite;
    opacity: 0;
  }
  @keyframes glitch-top {
    0%,85%,100% { opacity: 0; transform: translateX(0); }
    86% { opacity: 0.8; transform: translateX(-3px); }
    87% { opacity: 0; transform: translateX(3px); }
    89% { opacity: 0.6; transform: translateX(-2px); }
    90% { opacity: 0; }
  }
  @keyframes glitch-bot {
    0%,85%,100% { opacity: 0; transform: translateX(0); }
    86% { opacity: 0.8; transform: translateX(3px); }
    87% { opacity: 0; transform: translateX(-3px); }
    89% { opacity: 0.6; transform: translateX(2px); }
    90% { opacity: 0; }
  }

  .tag {
    font-family: 'Share Tech Mono', monospace;
    font-size: 10px;
    color: #555;
    letter-spacing: 4px;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    margin-bottom: 8px;
    text-align: center;
  }

  .bio {
    font-size: 11px;
    color: #444;
    text-align: center;
    letter-spacing: 1px;
    line-height: 2;
    margin-bottom: 32px;
  }

  /* ─── 픽셀 장식 바 ─── */
  .pixel-row {
    display: flex;
    gap: 4px;
    margin-bottom: 28px;
  }
  .pixel-row span {
    display: block;
    width: 5px; height: 5px;
    background: var(--accent);
    border-radius: 1px;
    animation: pixel-blink 2s ease-in-out infinite;
  }
  .pixel-row span:nth-child(1) { opacity: 0.1; animation-delay: 0s; }
  .pixel-row span:nth-child(2) { opacity: 0.2; animation-delay: 0.1s; }
  .pixel-row span:nth-child(3) { opacity: 0.5; animation-delay: 0.2s; }
  .pixel-row span:nth-child(4) { opacity: 1;   animation-delay: 0.3s; }
  .pixel-row span:nth-child(5) { opacity: 1;   animation-delay: 0.4s; }
  .pixel-row span:nth-child(6) { opacity: 0.5; animation-delay: 0.3s; }
  .pixel-row span:nth-child(7) { opacity: 0.2; animation-delay: 0.2s; }
  .pixel-row span:nth-child(8) { opacity: 0.1; animation-delay: 0.1s; }
  @keyframes pixel-blink {
    0%,100% { box-shadow: none; }
    50% { box-shadow: 0 0 8px var(--accent); }
  }

  /* ─── 구분선 ─── */
  .divider {
    width: 100%;
    height: 1px;
    background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, #ff00ff22, transparent);
    margin-bottom: 28px;
    position: relative;
    overflow: visible;
  }
  .divider::after {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    left: 50%; top: 50%;
    transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
    width: 6px; height: 6px;
    background: var(--accent);
    border-radius: 50%;
    box-shadow: 0 0 12px var(--accent);
    animation: div-pulse 3s ease-in-out infinite;
  }
  @keyframes div-pulse {
    0%,100% { transform: translate(-50%,-50%) scale(1); opacity: 1; }
    50% { transform: translate(-50%,-50%) scale(1.6); opacity: 0.5; }
  }

  /* ─── 소셜 아이콘 그리드 ─── */
  .social-icons {
    display: flex;
    gap: 20px;
    justify-content: center;
    align-items: center;
    margin-bottom: 40px;
  }

  .s-icon {
    position: relative;
    width: 64px; height: 64px;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    text-decoration: none;
    /* 유리 배경 */
    background: rgba(255,255,255,0.03);
    border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08);
    border-radius: 18px;
    backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
    transition: transform 0.25s cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1),
                border-color 0.25s,
                background 0.25s;
    /* 둥둥 떠있는 느낌 */
    animation: icon-float 3s ease-in-out infinite;
  }
  .s-icon:nth-child(1) { animation-delay: 0s; }
  .s-icon:nth-child(2) { animation-delay: 0.4s; }
  .s-icon:nth-child(3) { animation-delay: 0.8s; }
  .s-icon:nth-child(4) { animation-delay: 1.2s; }
  .s-icon:nth-child(5) { animation-delay: 1.6s; }

  @keyframes icon-float {
    0%,100% { transform: translateY(0px); }
    50%      { transform: translateY(-5px); }
  }

  /* 아이콘 SVG */
  .s-icon svg {
    width: 26px; height: 26px;
    fill: rgba(255,255,255,0.45);
    transition: fill 0.25s, filter 0.25s, transform 0.25s;
    position: relative; z-index: 1;
  }

  /* 뒤 글로우 레이어 */
  .s-icon::before {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    border-radius: 17px;
    opacity: 0;
    transition: opacity 0.3s;
    background: var(--glow-color, #ff00ff);
    filter: blur(18px);
    z-index: 0;
  }

  /* 상단 하이라이트 줄 */
  .s-icon::after {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    top: 0; left: 15%; right: 15%;
    height: 1px;
    background: rgba(255,255,255,0.15);
    border-radius: 50%;
    transition: background 0.25s;
  }

  /* 호버 */
  .s-icon:hover {
    transform: translateY(-8px) scale(1.12) !important;
    animation-play-state: paused;
    border-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.25);
    background: rgba(255,255,255,0.07);
  }
  .s-icon:hover::before { opacity: 0.35; }
  .s-icon:hover::after  { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.35); }
  .s-icon:hover svg {
    fill: #fff;
    filter: drop-shadow(0 0 8px var(--glow-color, #ff00ff));
    transform: scale(1.08);
  }

  /* 클릭 */
  .s-icon:active {
    transform: translateY(-4px) scale(1.05) !important;
  }

  /* 플랫폼별 글로우 컬러 */
  .si-discord  { --glow-color: #7289da; }
  .si-twitter  { --glow-color: #1d9bf0; }
  .si-youtube  { --glow-color: #ff2020; }
  .si-threads  { --glow-color: #eeeeee; }
  .si-telegram { --glow-color: #29b6f6; }

  /* 툴팁 */
  .s-icon .tip {
    position: absolute;
    bottom: -28px;
    left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%);
    font-family: 'Share Tech Mono', monospace;
    font-size: 9px;
    letter-spacing: 2px;
    color: #444;
    white-space: nowrap;
    opacity: 0;
    transition: opacity 0.2s, color 0.2s;
    text-transform: uppercase;
  }
  .s-icon:hover .tip {
    opacity: 1;
    color: rgba(255,255,255,0.5);
  }

  /* ─── 푸터 ─── */
  .footer {
    font-size: 9px;
    color: #222;
    letter-spacing: 3px;
    text-align: center;
    font-family: 'Share Tech Mono', monospace;
    line-height: 2;
  }

  .blink {
    animation: blink 1.2s step-end infinite;
  }
  @keyframes blink {
    0%,100% { opacity: 1; }
    50% { opacity: 0; }
  }

    /* ─── 픽셀아트 우주인 워킹 ─── */
  .px-walker-wrap {
    width: 100%;
    position: relative;
    height: 68px;
    margin-bottom: 10px;
    overflow: visible;
  }
  .px-walker {
    position: absolute;
    bottom: 0;
    animation: px-walk 5s linear infinite;
    filter: drop-shadow(0 0 6px #ff00ff66);
    left: 0;
  }
  /* 좌→우 이동 후 반전해서 우→좌 */
  @keyframes px-walk {
    0%   { left: 5%;  transform: scaleX(1);  }
    48%  { left: 75%; transform: scaleX(1);  }
    50%  { left: 75%; transform: scaleX(-1); }
    98%  { left: 5%;  transform: scaleX(-1); }
    100% { left: 5%;  transform: scaleX(1);  }
  }
  .px-astronaut { image-rendering: pixelated; overflow: visible; }
  /* 몸 바운스 */
  .px-body {
    animation: px-bounce 0.3s steps(1) infinite;
    transform-origin: 21px 50px;
  }
  @keyframes px-bounce {
    0%,100% { transform: translateY(0px); }
    50%     { transform: translateY(3px); }
  }
  /* 팔 A/B 프레임 교체 — 댄스 */
  .px-armA-L, .px-armA-R {
    animation: frame-A 0.3s steps(1) infinite;
  }
  .px-armB-L, .px-armB-R {
    animation: frame-B 0.3s steps(1) infinite;
  }
  @keyframes frame-A {
    0%,49% { opacity:1; }
    50%,100%{ opacity:0; }
  }
  @keyframes frame-B {
    0%,49% { opacity:0; }
    50%,100%{ opacity:1; }
  }
  /* 안테나 점 깜빡임 */
  .px-dot {
    animation: px-dot-blink 0.6s steps(1) infinite;
  }
  @keyframes px-dot-blink {
    0%,49%  { fill: #ff00ff; filter: drop-shadow(0 0 3px #ff00ff); }
    50%,100%{ fill: #440044; filter: none; }
  }

  /* ─── 음표 ─── */
  .music-note {
    position: absolute;
    font-size: 14px;
    pointer-events: none;
    animation: note-float 1.4s ease-in-out infinite;
    opacity: 0;
    user-select: none;
    text-shadow: 0 0 8px #ff00ff;
    color: #ff00ff;
  }
  .music-note.n2 { color: #cc88ff; text-shadow: 0 0 8px #cc88ff; animation-delay: 0.35s; font-size: 11px; }
  .music-note.n3 { color: #ffffff; text-shadow: 0 0 8px #ffffff88; animation-delay: 0.7s;  font-size: 10px; }
  .music-note.n4 { color: #ff00ff; text-shadow: 0 0 8px #ff00ff;  animation-delay: 1.05s; font-size: 13px; }
  /* 숫자 3·6·9 */
  .music-note.num {
    font-family: 'Press Start 2P', monospace;
    font-size: 9px;
    color: #00ffcc;
    text-shadow: 0 0 8px #00ffcc;
    animation-delay: 0.55s;
  }
  .music-note.num.n6 { color: #ffdd00; text-shadow: 0 0 8px #ffdd00; animation-delay: 1.0s; }
  .music-note.num.n9 { color: #ff6688; text-shadow: 0 0 8px #ff6688; animation-delay: 1.3s; }

  @keyframes note-float {
    0%   { opacity: 0;   transform: translateY(0px)  rotate(-10deg); }
    15%  { opacity: 1; }
    80%  { opacity: 0.7; transform: translateY(-22px) rotate(10deg); }
    100% { opacity: 0;   transform: translateY(-32px) rotate(15deg); }
  }

  /* ─── 커서 숨김 ─── */
  *, *::before, *::after { cursor: none !important; }

  /* ─── 커스텀 커서 — 크로스헤어 조준경 스타일 ─── */
  #cursor-dot {
    position: fixed;
    width: 6px; height: 6px;
    background: #ff00ff;
    border-radius: 50%;
    pointer-events: none;
    z-index: 9999;
    transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
    transition: transform 0.05s, opacity 0.2s;
    box-shadow: 0 0 10px #ff00ff, 0 0 20px #ff00ff66;
  }
  #cursor-ring {
    position: fixed;
    width: 28px; height: 28px;
    border: 1px solid #ff00ff88;
    border-radius: 50%;
    pointer-events: none;
    z-index: 9998;
    transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
    transition: width 0.2s, height 0.2s, border-color 0.2s;
  }
  /* 크로스헤어 선 4방향 */
  #cursor-ring::before, #cursor-ring::after {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    background: #ff00ff55;
  }
  #cursor-ring::before {
    width: 1px; height: 8px;
    left: 50%; top: -10px;
    transform: translateX(-50%);
    box-shadow: 0 36px 0 #ff00ff55;
  }
  #cursor-ring::after {
    height: 1px; width: 8px;
    top: 50%; left: -10px;
    transform: translateY(-50%);
    box-shadow: 36px 0 0 #ff00ff55;
  }
  /* 링크/버튼 호버 시 커서 확대 */
  body.cursor-hover #cursor-ring {
    width: 44px; height: 44px;
    border-color: #ff00ffcc;
  }
  body.cursor-hover #cursor-dot {
    transform: translate(-50%, -50%) scale(0.5);
    opacity: 0.6;
  }
  /* 클릭 시 수축 */
  body.cursor-click #cursor-ring {
    width: 18px; height: 18px;
    border-color: #ffffff;
  }

  /* ─── 마우스 트레일 ─── */
  .cursor-trail {
    position: fixed;
    width: 4px; height: 4px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    background: #ff00ff;
    pointer-events: none;
    z-index: 9997;
    transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
  }

  /* ─── 유성 효과 ─── */
  .meteor {
    position: fixed;
    top: 0;
    width: 1.5px;
    border-radius: 2px;
    pointer-events: none;
    z-index: 2;
    opacity: 0;
    transform-origin: top center;
  }
  @keyframes meteor-fall {
    0%   { opacity: 0;   transform: translateY(-120px) translateX(0)    rotate(20deg); }
    8%   { opacity: 1; }
    85%  { opacity: 0.6; }
    100% { opacity: 0;   transform: translateY(110vh)  translateX(100px) rotate(20deg); }
  }
</style>
</head>

    <span class="music-note num" style="left:48%; top:12px;">3</span>
    <span class="music-note num n6" style="left:63%; top:6px;">6</span>
    <span class="music-note num n9" style="left:40%; top:20px;">9</span>
  </div>

  <div class="social-icons fade-up">

    <a href="https://discord.gg/PGCbmnAPmY" class="s-icon si-discord" target="_blank" rel="noopener" title="Discord">

</div>

<script>
// ─── 별 파티클 캔버스 ───────────────────────────────────
const canvas = document.getElementById('star-canvas');
const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');

function resize() {
  canvas.width = window.innerWidth;
  canvas.height = window.innerHeight;
}
resize();
window.addEventListener('resize', resize);

const STAR_COUNT = 160;
const stars = [];

for (let i = 0; i < STAR_COUNT; i++) {
  stars.push({
    x: Math.random() * window.innerWidth,
    y: Math.random() * window.innerHeight,
    r: Math.random() * 1.5 + 0.2,
    // 일부는 마젠타, 나머지는 흰색
    color: Math.random() < 0.12 ? '#ff00ff' : '#ffffff',
    alpha: Math.random() * 0.7 + 0.1,
    alphaDir: Math.random() < 0.5 ? 1 : -1,
    alphaSpeed: Math.random() * 0.006 + 0.002,
    vx: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.08,
    vy: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.04 - 0.02,
  });
}

function drawStars() {
  ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
  stars.forEach(s => {
    s.alpha += s.alphaSpeed * s.alphaDir;
    if (s.alpha >= 0.8 || s.alpha <= 0.05) s.alphaDir *= -1;
    s.x += s.vx;
    s.y += s.vy;
    if (s.x < 0) s.x = canvas.width;
    if (s.x > canvas.width) s.x = 0;
    if (s.y < 0) s.y = canvas.height;
    if (s.y > canvas.height) s.y = 0;

    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, s.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fillStyle = s.color;
    ctx.globalAlpha = s.alpha;
    ctx.fill();

    // 마젠타 별에는 글로우
    if (s.color === '#ff00ff') {
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, s.r * 3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(s.x, s.y, 0, s.x, s.y, s.r * 3);
      grad.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,0,255,0.15)');
      grad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,0,255,0)');
      ctx.fillStyle = grad;
      ctx.fill();
    }
  });
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  requestAnimationFrame(drawStars);
}
drawStars();

// ─── 유성 생성 (대량, 빠른 간격) ──────────────────────
const METEOR_COLORS = [
  ['transparent','#ff00ff88','#ffffff'],
  ['transparent','#ffffff44','#ffffff'],
  ['transparent','#cc00ff66','#ff00ff'],
  ['transparent','#00ffff33','#aaffff'],
];

function spawnMeteor() {
  const col = METEOR_COLORS[Math.floor(Math.random() * METEOR_COLORS.length)];
  const len = 60 + Math.random() * 100;
  const m = document.createElement('div');
  m.className = 'meteor';
  m.style.left = (Math.random() * 100) + '%';
  m.style.height = len + 'px';
  m.style.background = `linear-gradient(180deg, ${col[0]}, ${col[1]}, ${col[2]})`;
  const dur = 0.8 + Math.random() * 1.2;
  m.style.animationDuration = dur + 's';
  m.style.animationName = 'meteor-fall';
  m.style.animationTimingFunction = 'linear';
  m.style.animationFillMode = 'forwards';
  document.body.appendChild(m);
  m.addEventListener('animationend', () => m.remove());
}

// 버스트 모드: 한 번에 2~3개씩, 짧은 간격으로
function meteorBurst() {
  const count = 2 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 2); // 2~3개
  for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
    setTimeout(spawnMeteor, i * (100 + Math.random() * 200));
  }
  // 다음 버스트: 0.8~2.5초 후
  setTimeout(meteorBurst, 800 + Math.random() * 1700);
}
setTimeout(meteorBurst, 600);


// ─── 음표 우주인 위치 추적 ────────────────────────────
const walker = document.querySelector('.px-walker');
const notes  = document.querySelectorAll('.music-note');

function syncNotes() {
  if (!walker) return;
  const rect = walker.getBoundingClientRect();
  const wrap  = document.querySelector('.px-walker-wrap').getBoundingClientRect();
  const relX  = rect.left - wrap.left + rect.width / 2;

  notes.forEach((n, i) => {
    const offsets = [8, 18, -8, 14];
    n.style.left = (relX + offsets[i]) + 'px';
  });
  requestAnimationFrame(syncNotes);
}
syncNotes();

// ─── 커스텀 커서 ──────────────────────────────────────
const curDot  = document.getElementById('cursor-dot');
const curRing = document.getElementById('cursor-ring');
const TRAIL_LEN = 8;
const trails = [];

for (let i = 0; i < TRAIL_LEN; i++) {
  const t = document.createElement('div');
  t.className = 'cursor-trail';
  t.style.opacity = ((TRAIL_LEN - i) / TRAIL_LEN * 0.4).toFixed(2);
  t.style.width = t.style.height = (4 - i * 0.3).toFixed(1) + 'px';
  document.body.appendChild(t);
  trails.push({ el: t, x: 0, y: 0 });
}

let mx = -200, my = -200;
let rx = -200, ry = -200;
const trailPos = Array(TRAIL_LEN).fill(null).map(() => ({ x: -200, y: -200 }));

document.addEventListener('mousemove', e => {
  mx = e.clientX;
  my = e.clientY;
});

document.addEventListener('mousedown', () => document.body.classList.add('cursor-click'));
document.addEventListener('mouseup',   () => document.body.classList.remove('cursor-click'));

// 호버 감지 (링크, 버튼)
document.querySelectorAll('a, button, .s-icon').forEach(el => {
  el.addEventListener('mouseenter', () => document.body.classList.add('cursor-hover'));
  el.addEventListener('mouseleave', () => document.body.classList.remove('cursor-hover'));
});

let frame = 0;
function animateCursor() {
  // 도트 — 마우스에 딱 붙음
  curDot.style.left = mx + 'px';
  curDot.style.top  = my + 'px';

  // 링 — 부드럽게 따라옴
  rx += (mx - rx) * 0.14;
  ry += (my - ry) * 0.14;
  curRing.style.left = rx + 'px';
  curRing.style.top  = ry + 'px';

  // 트레일 업데이트
  trailPos.unshift({ x: mx, y: my });
  trailPos.pop();
  trails.forEach((t, i) => {
    t.el.style.left = trailPos[i].x + 'px';
    t.el.style.top  = trailPos[i].y + 'px';
  });

  frame++;
  requestAnimationFrame(animateCursor);
}
animateCursor();

// ─── 인트로 스플래시 + 음악 제어 ──────────────────────
const bgm = document.getElementById('bgm');
const btn = document.getElementById('vol-btn');
const intro = document.getElementById('intro');
bgm.volume = 0.45;

// 인트로 클릭 → 음악 재생 + 페이드아웃
function enterSite() {
  bgm.play().then(() => btn.classList.add('playing')).catch(() => {});
  intro.classList.add('hidden');
  // 트랜지션 끝나면 DOM에서 제거
  intro.addEventListener('transitionend', () => intro.remove(), { once: true });
}

intro.addEventListener('click', enterSite);
intro.addEventListener('touchstart', enterSite);

// 볼륨 토글 버튼
btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
  if (bgm.paused) {
    bgm.play();
    btn.classList.add('playing');
  } else {
    bgm.pause();
    btn.classList.remove('playing');
  }
});

// ─── 링크 버튼 호버 시 파티클 버스트 ─────────────────
document.querySelectorAll('.link-btn').forEach(btn => {
  btn.addEventListener('mouseenter', function() {
    for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
      const p = document.createElement('span');
      p.style.cssText = `
        position:absolute; pointer-events:none;
        width:4px; height:4px;
        background: var(--accent);
        border-radius:50%;
        opacity:1;
        left:${Math.random()*100}%;
        top:${Math.random()*100}%;
        animation: spark 0.5s ease forwards;
      `;
      this.appendChild(p);
      setTimeout(() => p.remove(), 500);
    }
  });
});

// 버튼 파티클 CSS 동적 추가
const sparkStyle = document.createElement('style');
sparkStyle.textContent = `
@keyframes spark {
  to { transform: translate(${(Math.random()-0.5)*30}px,${(Math.random()-0.5)*30}px) scale(0); opacity:0; }
}`;
document.head.appendChild(sparkStyle);
</script>
</body>
</html>
